news.why: Contested, confusing claim (labs say models refuted ETH) that needs plain-language questions: what is ETH, what was claimed, is it machine-checked, what do experts doubt. Strongest story, so it leads. Not used for news alongside qa in the last 6 issues except 10-24, where it paired with different research/invention formats.

research.why: Single paper (AV-FABLE) where method, dataset and results need walking through: what they found, how it works, why it matters, what is uncertain. Explainer was last used for research on 10-03 and for invention on 10-10; used only once this issue.

invention.why: Switched from comparison after editor round 1: the ledger has no citable data on alternative tools, so a comparison table could not be supported. Short intro, five bolded ledger figures (RAM minimum, model sizes by RAM, 15 tokens/s picker floor, no telemetry, loop guard), then the honest caveat. by-the-numbers was used for invention on 10-24, but with different research/news formats, so the combination is new.

notes: Previous issue (10-24) used a question headline, so this one uses a claim headline. 09-30 issue frontmatter had no formats field in the first 40 lines; not needed for the 6-issue check since the five checked share no identical combination with this plan.
